envelope_semantics: request+response envelopes; refused messages are separate and have no response envelope

reconciliation.basis: authenticated client request/response linkage with recorded authentication refusals; server snapshots supplemental

nettop.reconciliation: Separate whole-process host view; no byte total inferred or added to WebSocket accounting

limitations: Application WebSocket payload/frame bytes only; handshake/control frames and TCP/IP bytes excluded
nettop is a separate host view and is not added to application counters
